note: WO-026 §3: KDP print settings, one entry per book id. White paper, black & white interior: KDP's cover calculator (https://kdp.amazon.co.jp/cover-calculator) gives 0.002252 in = 0.0572 mm of spine per page. Spine text needs more than 79 pages. `pnpm book <passId>` stops if an entry's page count differs from the built book; then update pages, spine_mm and spine_text here.
